info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Customer Application API
info.description: The Update Customer Application API allows businesses to modify application details associated with a specific customer. This endpoint enables the editing of critical application attributes to reflect the most current information or changes in customer circumstances. Typical users include customer support teams and account managers who manage customer data and applications. By providing this functionality, the API facilitates better compliance with customer requests and improved service delivery.

put.summary: Update an application for a specific customer.
put.description: This API endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific application associated with a customer. You need to provide the customer ID and application ID in the request URL, along with the updated application data in the request body.

requestBody.description: Use this request body to update the application details for the specified customer and application IDs. The payload should include all required fields and adhere to the specified schema.
